title: Appointment slot booking
when: The user wants a page where clients pick a service, a day and a free time slot and confirm a booking, stored locally with no server.
prompt:
Goal: Only truly free slots are offered, overlaps are impossible, and the booking is confirmed in plain words.
Steps:
1. Config: services with minutes, hours per weekday, breaks, slot step 15 or 30, days ahead.
2. logic.mjs slotsFor(day, service, config, bookings, now): starts where the whole duration fits, outside breaks, not overlapping (start < otherEnd and end > otherStart), not past; book() rejects taken slots.
3. Flow: service radio cards, a strip of the next 14 days (closed days disabled), slot buttons with aria-pressed, then a name and phone form.
4. Confirmation in role="status" with service, date, time and duration; offer an .ics download.
5. Owner view: bookings by day with Cancel.
6. State that bookings live in this browser only; persist in localStorage guarded.
7. test.mjs: back to back allowed, breaks, closing cut off, past hidden.
Quality bar:
- Times shown in local format.
- Disabled days explain why.
- Phone field uses type="tel".
Pitfalls:
- Slots that end after closing.
- Overlap check with less than or equal that blocks back to back.
- Implying the business got the booking.
Verify:
- [ ] Form labeled and submits.
- [ ] Status announced.
- [ ] Overlap tested.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (slots), test.mjs.

examples.input: agendamento de horarios para minha barbearia
examples.output: Corte 30 min, next 14 days, 09:00 to 18:00 slots, lunch break hidden
